name: core-intl-kok
title: Core: Konkani dates and hours
description: Days, months and the hours of the day in Konkani, in Devanagari and in Romi, the same in every engine. formatKonkani(at, { locale: 'gom-Deva', time: true }) reads 'शेनवार 21 नोव्हेंबर, सांजे 7:00' and 'gom-Latn' reads 'Sonvar 21 Novembr, sanje 7:00', in IST whatever the visitor's zone. The tag is mapped gom to kok with its script kept, the engine's own words are probed (Chromium has only a root pattern for Devanagari Konkani and WebKit has no gom alias) and a table of ICU's forms answers when the probe fails. The parts of the day (सकाळीं, दनपारां, सांजे, राती) always come from the table. Draft words, for a native reader. Pure; the formatter can be swapped, so tests fake the engine.

budget.reason: A pure core: two small tables (days, months and the four parts of the day, in two scripts; Devanagari costs three bytes a letter) and the probe. 7.6 KB today with comments, so about 7% to spare.

motif.gloss: The days and months as Goan Konkani says them; words only, nothing drawn.
